jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Fraud Prevention
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building highly scalable distributed systems that protect millions of customers? Do you want to work on a team that has AI first approach to all problems? The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team is looking for a talented SDE to help us stay one step ahead of bad actors. You'll design and build systems that process millions of events per second, develop machine learning-powered detection pipelines, and directly contribute to keeping AWS safe. Whether it's architecting a new real-time detection engine, optimizing our graph-based fraud network analysis, or hardening our registration fraud defenses your work will have immediate, measurable impact at AWS scale. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and operate highly scalable distributed systems to create backend services and serverless workflows that take actions where correctness directly protects AWS customers and revenue. - Own features end to end: write design docs, implement in Java/TypeScript on Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge, and ship through CDK-managed pipelines that deploy to 38+ commercial regions plus GovCloud and sovereign clouds. - Write high-quality, production-ready code for services that must be available 24/7 with zero tolerance for downtime. - Own the full lifecycle of your solutions — from design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence. - Build agentic and LLM-based automation that triages fraud signals and use AI developer tools daily. - Learn from others, mentor teammates, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement. - Collaborate with applied scientists to integrate machine learning models into real-time decisioning systems. - Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where you're solving complex problems with direct, measurable impact on AWS security. About the team The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make split-second decisions to stop bad actors — from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our stack includes Apache Flink for stream processing, AWS Neptune for graph-based intelligence, and machine learning models for adaptive detection. We're a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, VA, Arlington - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Customer Experience Improvement - Defect Enrichment
jobs.description: We see our customers as invited guests to a party, and we are the hosts. It's our job every day to make every important aspect of the customer experience a little bit better." - Jeff Bezos, Founder & CEO We didn’t make Amazon a trillion-dollar company, our customers did, and we want to ensure that our customers always have a positive experience that keeps them coming back to Amazon. To help achieve this, the Customer Experience Improvement (CXI) team, within Amazon Customer Service (CS), relentlessly focuses on maintaining customer trust by building products that offer appropriate resolutions to resolve issues faced by our customers. CXI engineers solve complex problems and build scalable, robust solutions to help our customers navigate through issues and eliminate systemic defects to prevent future issues and identify critical customer experience improvement opportunities. This role will leverage latest technologies and Agentic AI solutions to autonomously eliminate defects at scale to improve customer experience. Key job responsibilities - Design, develop, and own scalable solutions that empower Amazon to deliver a defect-free experience for customers. - Build intuitive tools for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) to escalate critical issues, and develop complex integrations with Tier-1 Amazon systems and advanced science models to detect, triage, and resolve systemic defects. - Tackle complex technical challenges, create innovative solutions with direct impact on customer trust, and work on systems critical to Amazon's operational excellence. About the team ARCADE (Automated Root Causing, Attribution and Defect Elimination) is the Defect Elimination system within CXI Tech, manifesting Amazon's commitment to preventing customers from receiving defective products that degrade their experience. ARCADE leverages AI to transform how we detect repeat negative customer experiences and eliminate the underlying upstream defects at scale. The CXI Tech team re-imagines how we leverage customer interactions and feedback — through modular capabilities spanning Detection, Triage, Root Cause, Attribution, and Resolution — to enable more reliable and faster defect elimination that drives customer experience improvements throughout the consumer business. The system combines associate-driven signals (empowering front-line CSAs to flag product problems) with statistical and machine learning-based automated detection, intelligent prioritization, and increasingly autonomous investigation through our agentic ecosystem. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AI Foundations, Amazon Leo Networking Software
jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. The AI Foundations team builds AI agents that turn Leo's best troubleshooting expertise into diagnoses in minutes instead of hours, helping keep the network available for every customer. As a Software Development Engineer on AI Foundations, you will design and build production agentic systems on AWS that reason over real satellite, ground, and network data. You will work directly with principal engineers and network operators, and your work will shape how Leo is operated at scale. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and operate AI agents and services that diagnose network and connectivity issues using telemetry, logs, and engineering knowledge. - Turn proven engineering tools and data sources into reusable agent tools so teams across Leo can build on them. - Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent accuracy, coverage, and latency, and use them to gate launches. - Own your services in production: on-call, operational metrics, root-cause analysis, and security reviews. - Partner with principal engineers, operators, and program managers to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features. - Write clear design docs, give thoughtful code reviews, and help teammates adopt agentic development practices. A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing overnight evaluation results and spotting a class of network failures your agent misdiagnosed. You trace the gap to a missing data source, then sit down with the principal engineer who owns that subsystem to agree on how to expose their tool to the agent. After lunch you build the integration and add new test cases, then review a teammate's pull request. Late afternoon, you join an operations review where an operator walks through a real incident your agent helped resolve, and you leave with a clear next priority. About the team AI Foundations is a new team in Amazon Leo's networking software organization. Our mission is to help Leo reach and sustain its network availability goals by turning the organization's best troubleshooting expertise into AI agents anyone can use. We build the shared foundations (agent tooling, evaluation, and integrations) that let engineering and operations teams across Leo ship their own agents safely. Because the team is early, you will help shape its architecture, engineering bar, and culture. We value builders who are curious about how satellite networks work, measure what they ship, and prefer simple systems that operators trust. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
